_note: Convention taken from OutputBox/WIRE/{YYYY_MM}/, which is the authoritative post-rename form: WIRE_{parNumber}_${amount}.pdf. This is NOT the form used in Shared Documents/Intake_Wires (Wire__$amount_MM_DD_YYYY) -- that is the pre-rename state. The PAR Number is a U.S. Bank SinglePoint wire reference, YYMMDD + B + 2 digits + 3 alphanumerics. OCR corrupts it systematically: 251103B02FHR reads as "251'103802FH   R" (B becomes 8). The validate regex REQUIRES a literal B in position 7, so a corrupted reference fails validation and lands on the exception path rather than producing a confidently wrong name -- the malformed live files WIRE_251125801YWH_... and WIRE_2511258020FR_... are that exact failure leaking through an earlier attempt.
